title: Tryptic (Trypticase) Soy Agar

references.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

purpose: A nutritionally rich general-purpose medium supporting a wide range of both fastidious and non-fastidious organisms, commonly used for cultivation, subculturing, and as a base for blood agar.
targetOrganisms: Broad range of bacteria, including many fastidious organisms compared to plain Nutrient Agar

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

preparationSummary: Suspend the dehydrated powder in distilled/deionized water per the manufacturer's stated concentration, heat to dissolve fully, then sterilize before pouring plates.

sterilization.value: commonly autoclaved at 121°C for 15 minutes for typical batch volumes

storage: Refrigerate prepared plates (commonly 2–8°C) in sealed bags.
expectedAppearance: Pale amber, clear to slightly opalescent gel.
qualityControl: Confirm sterility with an uninoculated control and verify growth of known reference organisms.
manufacturerNotes: TSA is the solid form of Tryptic Soy Broth (TSB); confirm exact composition against the specific product in use, since 'soy-based general medium' formulations vary between manufacturers.
